entities.summary: Isa Genzken is a German artist who lives and works in Berlin. Her primary media are sculpture and installation, using a wide variety of materials, including concrete, plaster, wood and textile. She also works with photography, video, film and collage. Isa Genzken was a painters & sculptors from Bad Oldesloe (b. 1948-11-27, Bad Oldesloe). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
